svg.text: Carved side band · tilet zigzag between Aksum stelae windows
Runs right round the board: 32 equal repeats of 42.4 (0.848). Raised parts are the original surface; the rest is cut 1.5 (0.03) deep.
window blocks 3.5 (0.07) and 1.8 (0.035) wide in turn, every 7.1 (0.141), 3.9 (0.077) tall
white = surface, black = cut; band-height-tile.svg is one exact repeat
LAYOUT ROUND THE SIDE · 32 repeats · 1 p = 50 px
repeat 1: peak at the middle of A's side
Dots: zigzag peaks. Ticks: joins between repeats.
A quarter of the way round is exactly 8 repeats, so peaks also sit
at the middle of B's side and at the tip of each end.
Round the ends the band bends with the wood; it is never stretched.
On the side: band top 8.7 (0.175) below the top face, bottom 8.8 (0.175) above the underside.
Redrawn as clean geometry from image 15: same rhythm and proportions; no religious symbols.
Ease every cut edge by about 0.2 mm.
For 3D: band-height-tile.svg as the bump/normal map, 32 tiles round the perimeter.
Repeat 1 p = 700 px; height map 250 px; layout 50 px
